evidence.title: Animated Components for React Native & Expo Apps

name: Curtain
summary: Gesture-controlled curtain reveal animation component for React Native, built with Skia, Reanimated and Gesture Handler.
description: Self-contained copy-paste React Native component: a bezier-curve curtain that reveals the content behind, driven by a Reanimated shared value (0-1). Props cover width, height, minY, maxY, curtain colors, container style and an onAnimationEnd callback.
contains: single copy-paste Curtain.tsx component, no setup
gesture-controlled curtain with bezier curve transitions
controllable through an external shared value (0-1)
props: progress, width, height, minY, maxY, colors, onAnimationEnd, containerStyle
requires React Native Reanimated, Skia and Gesture Handler
